system_a.summary: Recent reviews (2024–2026) are largely positive. Guests describe a clean, spacious basement apartment with a comfortable bed, full kitchen, sauna, coffee bar, and an honor-system drink and snack bar. They praise the central location, close to restaurants and downtown, with a private entrance and parking steps from the door. Brady is described as responsive and friendly, and check-in as easy. Many recent guests said they heard no noise from the adjoining residence. Two reported footsteps from upstairs: one found it mild with a noise machine, and another heard it from 7am to 9pm and used headphones. One reviewer called the space best for a short stay. Historical reviews (2016–2018) raised more serious complaints, including cleanliness, musty odors, dated furnishings, no TV, no temperature control, and limited privacy through a shared laundry room. Later reviews did not repeat the cleanliness complaints, but these reports reflect guest experiences, not verified current conditions.

system_b.summary: Reviews of this Asheville unit, spanning 2016–2026, most consistently praise its location: reviewers describe a short, inexpensive ride or roughly 10-minute drive downtown, with nearby restaurants. A 2016 reviewer called it about a mile out, hilly and not bike-friendly. Many guests call it clean, while two 2016 reviews reported bugs, mildew and a mildew-smelling couch; no later cleanliness complaints appear, though resolution can't be confirmed. Noise is mixed: many 2025 reviews report quiet, though their wording is repetitive and may not be independent, while upstairs footsteps were reported in 2018, 2025 and June 2026. Privacy concerns (a 2016 interior stairway door, a 2018 unlocked shared laundry room) contrast with praise for the private entrance. Amenities such as the sauna (2023–2026) and bed draw praise; limited light, dated furnishings and a small bathroom were also noted. Hosts are generally described as responsive, with one 2016 complaint. Current conditions are not confirmed.

selected_claims.claim: Location is the most consistently praised feature: reviewers across all years describe it as close to downtown Asheville (short, inexpensive rideshare or roughly 10-minute drive), with restaurants walkable nearby. One 2016 reviewer called it about a mile from downtown, not bike-friendly, on a hilly alley, with peak Uber fares around $20.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Praise spans 2016-2026, including recent 2025-2026 reviews; the negative view is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Walkability to downtown is not described as direct; fares and times vary by reviewer.

selected_claims.claim: Many reviewers describe the unit as clean, with several using words like spotless or sparkling. A single 2016 review reported filthy conditions, bugs, spiders and mildew, and a second 2016 review reported a mildew-smelling couch. No later cleanliness complaints appear in the ledger.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative reports are from 2016 only; positive reports run through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Cannot confirm whether the 2016 issues were resolved; the ledger shows no recent recurrence.

selected_claims.claim: Noise is mixed. Most reviewers report a quiet stay, and a large batch of 2025 reviews report little or no noise from the adjoining residence. However, others report audible upstairs footsteps: one in 2018 (thin floors, until past midnight), one in 2025 (mild with a noise machine, with mention that others noted it), and one in June 2026 (heard roughly 7am-9pm; headphones used).
selected_claims.time_qualification: Footstep complaints span 2018 and 2025-2026, so the issue is not purely historical.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The 2025 positive noise reviews use highly repetitive wording, so they may not be fully independent evidence. Noise likely depends on upstairs occupancy.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy and security concerns are raised by a minority. A 2016 reviewer described an interior stairway door linking the unit to the upstairs house and said they feared occupants entering. A 2018 reviewer said the shared laundry room, which can be locked, was unlocked on arrival and that the unit was less private than described. Other reviewers praise the private entrance, separate driveway, and privacy.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Concerns date from 2016 and 2018; praise for privacy runs through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No recent report confirms or rules out these access issues; the current door and laundry configuration is unknown.

selected_claims.claim: Neighborhood safety is described positively by several reviewers, including a solo female traveler in 2023.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Subjective impressions from a few reviewers.

selected_claims.claim: Amenities draw wide praise: full kitchen, sauna (frequently mentioned from late 2023 onward), coffee bar, honor-system snacks and beer, good water pressure, and private parking. Some earlier reviewers noted no TV or coffee, sparse or odd kitchen organization, and a 2016 parking conflict with an upstairs guest's friend.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Sauna praise is recent (2023-2026); TV and parking complaints are from 2016-2018.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The listing's TV status is unclear; one 2022 review mentions a Roku TV.

selected_claims.claim: Comfort is generally praised, especially the bed and linens, but some reviewers note limited natural light (walkout basement), a small bathroom, and worn or dated furnishings. A 2016 reviewer said the unit was dark and dingy with a poor bed and heat/cooling controlled by the upstairs house.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Temperature control and lighting may still apply; no recent reports address them.

selected_claims.claim: Hosts are described as responsive, accommodating and friendly, and check-in is repeatedly called easy, including flexible or early access and a flat driveway by the door. One 2016 guest found the host brief and unreachable for a weekend.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Consistent from 2016 to 2026; the negative report is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Single complaint; no recent contrary reports.

selected_claims.claim: Value and listing accuracy are mostly positive (reasonable price, as described), but some guests call it basic, dated, or best for a short stay. One 2016 guest felt $150/night was poor value. One 2016 review called the photos misleading, and another reviewer reported no TV despite the listing, and another said it was less private than described.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative accuracy and value reports are from 2016-2018; positive ones continue through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Prices have likely changed; accuracy complaints are from a few reviewers and unverified. R0005 also questions other reviews, which is an unverified claim.
